key_decisions: MpiH3References DELEGATES to core's MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo rather than copying its tensor maths. Verified byte-identical (md5 422138bb) between engine v0.30.0 and bench v0.30.2, so the delegation is safe across both.

DO NOT BUMP ComfyUI for this. The H3 node file is identical in 0.30.0 and 0.30.2, and only v0.30.0 publishes a Windows portable build — 0.30.1/0.30.2 are tags with no release assets, so there is nothing to bump the shipped engine to.

The empty-slot sentinel is EXACT, not heuristic: the Mpi loaders with block_if_empty OFF emit a 1x1 image and a 1-sample waveform, which real media cannot be. A genuinely black reference and a genuinely silent clip both pass through. Do not replace this with a content/brightness test.

ref2va references are NEVER cropped or resized app-side. Both match and max are aspect-preserving down-only scales done by the node, and neither crops. fl2va crops because a keyframe literally becomes frame 0 / frame N-1; a reference never touches the canvas. Capping uploads at a 2048 short edge is the only worthwhile app-side step.

ref_image_size ships as `match` and `max` is the user's explicit choice. Measured 2026-08-07 with ONE reference: match 11-12 s/step, max 14 s/step. Reference tokens ride through EVERY sampling step, so nine refs at max is far steeper than that 20%.

The r2va preview clip (the accidental 10-second script compressed into 1 second) is a PLACEHOLDER by the user's decision. It was made with one reference, so do not caption it as a multi-reference showcase.
1.4 ships on the H3 hype window — that is the stated priority, so MPI-475 is the critical path.
